content: Official Next.js JSON-LD guide (nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/json-ld): render structured data as <script type='application/ld+json' dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd).replace(/</g,'\\u003c')}} /> directly in page.tsx/layout.tsx Server Components. JSON.stringify does NOT sanitize XSS — MUST escape '<' to \u003c manually before injecting. next/script is NOT the right tool (that's for executable JS, not structured data). Optional: schema-dts (Google, MIT, mature, 2M+ weekly downloads) gives compile-time TypeScript types for JSON-LD shapes — purely type-only, zero runtime, verified OK by package-legitimacy check.
